fields.title: Source (JSON) column
fields.description: The input JSON column to be the base for the patch.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Target (JSON) column
fields.description: The input JSON column to be the result after the patch.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Remove source column
fields.description: When checked, the source column will be removed.

fields.title: New column name
fields.description: The name of the new output column that will contain the JSON patch (diff) from the source.
